entries.text: We are to give glory and praise unto God.

text.text: Give unto the Lord, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.
Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
Ye that fear the Lord, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
Let them give glory unto the Lord, and declare his praise in the islands.
This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

entries.text: We should glorify God in body and spirit.

text.text: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.

entries.text: Whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

text.text: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

entries.text: Let no one glory or boast in men.

text.text: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;
Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

entries.text: Praise should be offered to God continually.

text.text: I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

entries.text: We are to give to God the glory and praise due to his name (the LORD's name is to be praised).

text.text: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
Praise ye the Lord. Praise, O ye servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.
From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the Lord’s name is to be praised.
Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; praise him, O ye servants of the Lord.
I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.
Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
O Lord, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.

entries.text: Praise and exalt the name of God with song.

text.text: The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
Sing praises to the Lord, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the Lord.
Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.
Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah, and rejoice before him.
Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O Lord, will I sing.
Praise the Lord; for the Lord is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
And in that day shall ye say, Praise the Lord, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
Sing unto the Lord; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
For thus saith the Lord; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O Lord, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.

entries.text: Punishment for not giving glory unto the name of God.

text.text: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath is, and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:

If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the Lord of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.
And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

entries.text: Glorify God to others by your good works which they may observe.

text.text: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

entries.text: He who glories, let him glory in the LORD.

text.text: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the Lord which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the Lord.
That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

entries.text: Praise and extol the LORD in the congregation of the people and among the multitude.

text.text: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
Praise ye the Lord. I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
